module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters for depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define internal signals
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM[DEPTH-1:0];
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] raddr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] waddr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_syn;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_syn;
        reg wen;
        reg ren;
        // Assign outputs to internal signals
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr[WIDTH-1], rptr[WIDTH-2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr);
        assign rdata = rdata;
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram_inst (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
        
        // Write Pointer Logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr <= waddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr <= raddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Convert Binary to Gray Code
        function [WIDTH-1:0] bin_to_gray(input [WIDTH-1:0] bin);
            integer i;
            begin
                bin_to_gray[WIDTH-1] = bin[WIDTH-1];
                for (i = WIDTH-2; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    bin_to_gray[i] = bin[i+1] ^ bin[i];
                end
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Convert Gray Code to Binary
        function [WIDTH-1:0] gray_to_bin(input [WIDTH-1:0] gray);
            integer i;
            begin
                gray_to_bin[WIDTH-1] = gray[WIDTH-1];
                for (i = WIDTH-2; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    gray_to_bin[i] = gray_to_bin[i+1] ^ gray[i];
                end
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Write Pointer Buffer Logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Buffer Logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize Write Pointer Logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize Read Pointer Logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Full Signal Logic
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr[WIDTH-1], rptr[WIDTH-2:0]});
        
        // Empty Signal Logic
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr);
        
        // Write Enable Logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (winc && !wfull) begin
                wen = 1;
            end else begin
                wen = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Enable Logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                ren = 1;
            end else begin
                ren = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Write Address Logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (wen) begin
                waddr = waddr;
            end else begin
                waddr = waddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Address Logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (ren) begin
                raddr = raddr;
            end else begin
                raddr = raddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Write Data Logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (wen) begin
                wdata = wdata;
            end else begin
                wdata = wdata + 1;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Implement dual-port RAM here
        // Implement write and read controllers here
        // Implement read pointer synchronizers here
        // Implement write pointer synchronizers here
        // Implement empty/full signal generation here
        // Connect input/output signals to dual-port RAM
    </implementation>
</module>
